# use-encoding

RustUse encoding utilities and facade set.

## Set links

- Canonical set page: https://rustuse.org/use-encoding/
- Set overview alias: https://rustuse.org/sets/use-encoding/
- Workspace Rustdocs: https://rustuse.org/api/workspaces/use-encoding/
- Repository: https://github.com/RustUse/use-encoding
- Root LLM routing map: https://rustuse.org/llms.txt
- Full RustUse context: https://rustuse.org/llms-full.txt

## Parent RustUse links

- Primary site: https://rustuse.org/
